desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Games Tower! 🎮🏆

Choose between 2 games and decide which world you want to enter! 👀🕹️
Once the choice is made, 2 characters from the winning game will appear, one male and one female, and the entire stage will transform into the theme of that game! ✨

Every decision changes your journey:
🎮 iconic games and legendary franchises
👫 male & female characters from each game
🌎 stages inspired by the game you choose
🔥 unexpected matchups between completely different universes

Examples:
⛏️ Minecraft or Fortnite?
🍏 Blox Fruits or 99 Nights in the Forest?
🍄 Super Mario or Sonic?
🌴 GTA VI or Dress to Impress?
🌻 Plants vs. Zombies or Angry Birds?
💚 The Sims 4 or Animal Crossing?

⚠️ WARNING: choosing your favorite game might be harder than you think! ⚠️
Pick a door, enter its universe, and keep climbing the tower! 🎮🚪

Reach the top and prove you have the BEST gaming taste! 🏆🔥
